footerPages.about.page.title: About Us
footerPages.about.page.description: Learn about our story, values, and team.
footerPages.about.hero.title: About Us
footerPages.about.hero.description: Learn more about our story, our values, and the team behind your favourite online shopping destination.
footerPages.about.sections.story.title: Our Story
footerPages.about.sections.story.p1: Founded with a passion for delivering exceptional products at fair prices, our store began as a small operation with a big dream: to make quality shopping accessible to everyone. Over the years, we have grown into a trusted destination for thousands of customers worldwide, but our core mission remains unchanged.
footerPages.about.sections.story.p2: Every product in our catalogue is carefully selected by our dedicated curation team. We partner with reputable manufacturers and artisans who share our commitment to craftsmanship, durability, and design. Whether you are looking for everyday essentials or something special, we are here to help you find exactly what you need.
footerPages.about.sections.story.p3: Our fulfilment centres are strategically located to ensure fast, reliable delivery no matter where you are. We pride ourselves on meticulous packing and real-time order tracking, so you always know when to expect your order.
footerPages.about.sections.mission.title: Our Mission
footerPages.about.sections.mission.p1: We believe shopping should be seamless, enjoyable, and secure. Our mission is to remove the friction from online retail by offering intuitive browsing, transparent pricing, and a checkout experience that takes seconds, not minutes.
footerPages.about.sections.mission.p2: Customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do. Our support team is available around the clock to answer questions, resolve issues, and ensure every interaction leaves you feeling valued. We do not just sell products; we build lasting relationships with our community.
footerPages.about.values.quality.title: Quality
footerPages.about.values.quality.description: We source and curate only the finest products, ensuring every item meets our rigorous standards before it reaches your doorstep.
footerPages.about.values.trust.title: Trust
footerPages.about.values.trust.description: Transparent pricing, honest product descriptions, and a no-hassle return policy build the foundation of our relationship with every customer.
footerPages.about.values.innovation.title: Innovation
footerPages.about.values.innovation.description: We continuously evolve our platform and product range to bring you the latest trends and most convenient shopping experience.
footerPages.about.values.sustainability.title: Sustainability
footerPages.about.values.sustainability.description: From eco-friendly packaging to ethical sourcing partnerships, we're committed to reducing our environmental footprint.

footerPages.faq.page.title: FAQ
footerPages.faq.page.description: Frequently asked questions about shopping, shipping, returns, and more.
footerPages.faq.hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
footerPages.faq.hero.description: Find answers to the most common questions about shopping with us.
footerPages.faq.q1.question: How do I place an order?
footerPages.faq.q1.answer: Simply browse our catalogue, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout.
footerPages.faq.q2.question: What payment methods do you accept?
footerPages.faq.q2.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
footerPages.faq.q3.question: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
footerPages.faq.q3.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement.
footerPages.faq.q4.question: How long does shipping take?
footerPages.faq.q4.answer: Standard shipping takes 5-8 business days within the continental US.
footerPages.faq.q5.question: Do you offer free shipping?
footerPages.faq.q5.answer: Yes, we offer free standard shipping on all orders over $75.
footerPages.faq.q6.question: What is your return policy?
footerPages.faq.q6.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unworn items in original condition.
footerPages.faq.q7.question: How do I track my order?
footerPages.faq.q7.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number.
footerPages.faq.q8.question: Do you ship internationally?
footerPages.faq.q8.answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide.
footerPages.faq.q9.question: How can I contact customer support?
footerPages.faq.q9.answer: You can reach us via email at support@onstore.com or by phone.
footerPages.faq.q10.question: Is my personal information secure?
footerPages.faq.q10.answer: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data.
footerPages.faq.cta.title: Still have questions?
footerPages.faq.cta.description: Our performance support team is ready to help.

footerPages.terms.sections.1.content: By accessing or using our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use our services. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time, and continued use constitutes acceptance of the changes.
footerPages.terms.sections.2.title: 2. Account Registration
footerPages.terms.sections.2.content: When creating an account, you must provide accurate, complete information and keep it up to date. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use.
footerPages.terms.sections.3.title: 3. Orders & Pricing
footerPages.terms.sections.3.content: All prices are listed in USD and exclude applicable taxes and shipping fees, which are calculated at checkout. We reserve the right to modify prices at any time without prior notice. We may cancel any order if the product is unavailable, pricing errors occur, or fraudulent activity is suspected.
footerPages.terms.sections.4.title: 4. Product Availability
footerPages.terms.sections.4.content: Product availability is subject to change without notice. While we strive to display accurate stock information, occasionally an item may be out of stock after your order is placed. In such cases, we will notify you and issue a full refund for the unavailable item.

You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our express written permission.
footerPages.terms.sections.6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
footerPages.terms.sections.6.content: Our store shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our website or products. Our total liability is limited to the amount paid for the product or service giving rise to the claim.
footerPages.terms.sections.7.title: 7. Governing Law
footerPages.terms.sections.7.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of law provisions. Any disputes shall be resolved exclusively in the courts located in New York County.
footerPages.terms.sections.8.title: 8. Contact
footerPages.terms.sections.8.content: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact our support team at support@onstore.com or through our Contact page.
footerPages.privacy.page.title: Privacy Policy
footerPages.privacy.page.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
footerPages.privacy.hero.title: Privacy Policy
footerPages.privacy.hero.description: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
footerPages.privacy.sections.1.title: 1. Information We Collect
footerPages.privacy.sections.1.content: When you create an account, place an order, or subscribe to our newsletter, we collect personal information such as your name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and payment details. We also automatically collect certain data when you browse our site, including your IP address, browser type, device information, and browsing behaviour through cookies and similar technologies.
footerPages.privacy.sections.2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
footerPages.privacy.sections.2.content: We use your information to process and fulfil your orders, communicate with you about your purchases, send promotional offers (with your consent), improve our website and services, and prevent fraudulent activity. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
footerPages.privacy.sections.3.title: 3. Payment Processing
footerPages.privacy.sections.3.content: All payment transactions are processed through secure, PCI-compliant payment gateways. We do not store full credit card numbers or sensitive authentication data on our servers. Your payment details are encrypted using industry-standard TLS technology.
footerPages.privacy.sections.4.title: 4. Cookies
footerPages.privacy.sections.4.content: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyse site traffic. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our site.
footerPages.privacy.sections.5.title: 5. Your Rights
footerPages.privacy.sections.5.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You may also opt out of marketing communications by updating your account preferences or clicking the unsubscribe link in any email. To exercise any of these rights, contact our privacy team at privacy@onstore.com.
footerPages.privacy.sections.6.title: 6. Data Retention
footerPages.privacy.sections.6.content: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy or as required by law. Once no longer needed, your information is securely deleted or anonymised.
footerPages.privacy.sections.7.title: 7. Updates to This Policy
footerPages.privacy.sections.7.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

footerPages.shipping.sections.methods.description: We offer a range of shipping options to suit your needs and budget. All orders are shipped from our warehouses within the continental US.
footerPages.shipping.sections.processing.description: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days after payment confirmation. During peak periods (holidays, sales events), processing may take up to 3 business days. You will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information as soon as your order leaves our warehouse.
footerPages.shipping.sections.tracking.description: Every order includes free tracking. Once shipped, you can monitor your package's journey through your account dashboard or via the tracking link sent to your email. Tracking updates typically appear within 24 hours of shipment.
footerPages.shipping.sections.international.descript: We ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International orders may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, and brokerage fees, which are the responsibility of the recipient. Delivery times for international orders are estimates and may be affected by customs clearance processes. We recommend checking your local customs policies before placing an order.
footerPages.shipping.sections.restrictions.descripti: We currently do not ship to PO boxes, APO/FPO addresses, or certain remote locations. Some items with specific shipping restrictions (e.g., oversized or hazardous materials) may only be available for standard delivery within the continental US.
footerPages.shipping.sections.lostDamaged.descriptio: If your package arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours with photos of the damage and we will arrange a replacement or refund. For lost packages, we will initiate an investigation with the carrier and keep you updated throughout the process.
